title: Bitcoin slips below $70,000 as the AI trade wobbles
summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 on Friday and was down 4.6% at about $68,192, Bloomberg reported, extending a slide that began when Nvidia's chief executive resigned. Cointelegraph reported that the token had already broken below $72,000 on Thursday for the first time since 20 August, with month-to-date losses of 7.4%, as chip stocks sold off and traders waited for US producer price data. Ether and other large tokens fell alongside it.
